snippet.title: Soul Riders - Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Soul Riders is a casual party racing game heavily inspired by Kirby Air Ride. 
Each round starts with a roaming portion where players collect stat boosts for their chosen vehicle, mess with other players and experience the chaotic fun each unique map has to offer. Then it's off to the races! Face off with other players in a series of varied minigames using your upgraded vehicle. 
Winner of the minigames takes all!!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1873220/Soul_Riders/
Twitter (X): https://twitter.com/room322games
Discord: https://discord.gg/vG8eEfuEzh

Trailer Edited By: Haley Hoff
